operator_notes_2026_08_09: 2026-08-09 fix: download step had a pinned dated 'url' (June's bulletin210611sunot.pdf) that the recipe's own operator_notes say never to pin. The date-rewrite regex doesn't recognise this filename's DDMMYY placement, so it kept 404ing on the exact trained June URL every week instead of falling straight through to live-page pattern matching (url_pattern already correctly set to *bulletin*.pdf). Removed the pinned url field.
operator_notes: Permanent /parish-bulletin/ URL — PDF filename changes weekly under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/.
On the bulletin page: tap the green Save bulletin PDF (from embed) button.
Use url_pattern *bulletin*.pdf — never pin a dated filename.
do_not: Do not train on the homepage — use the dedicated bulletin page only.
Do not pin saintanthony.co.uk if the parish moved to saintanthonys.uk.
